title: dembrane v3: AI usage and cost
description: What AI costs and where it goes: total, per account, feature, operation and model, with budgets and trends. The same numbers and names as the staff AI costs panel, plus history. Days are UTC. Names only, never text.

list.name: account
list.label: Account
list.query: SELECT name || ' · ' || left(billing_account_id::text, 8) AS __text, billing_account_id::text AS __value FROM obs.ai_accounts ORDER BY name, billing_account_id
list.definition: SELECT name || ' · ' || left(billing_account_id::text, 8) AS __text, billing_account_id::text AS __value FROM obs.ai_accounts ORDER BY name, billing_account_id

options.content: Days are UTC. Cost shows four decimals, cut off and never rounded up, the same as the staff AI costs panel; budgets show two. Cost panels follow the time picker (this month so far by default); cost is rounded to the day, so a range always covers whole days. The budget, percent used and override columns and the list of free accounts near their budget show where each account stands right now and do not follow the time picker. The staff AI costs panel can switch between this month and last month; on its Last month view it shows last month's budgets, so compare only the cost columns for a past month. The Account dropdown filters the By feature, By operation and By model tables; unattributed and internal spend has no account and only shows under All.

panels.title: Total spend
panels.description: All AI cost in the selected time: accounts, internal and unattributed. Same as the total of the staff AI costs panel for the same month.

targets.rawSql: select trunc(coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur), 0) / 1000000.0, 4) as value from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Charged to accounts
panels.description: Cost charged to a customer account (payer is account), including accounts deleted since.

targets.rawSql: select trunc(coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur), 0) / 1000000.0, 4) as value from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and payer = 'account'

panels.title: Unattributed
panels.description: Cost with no account to charge it to. Same as Unattributed in the staff panel. Green at zero, red above: in a healthy system it is zero, and the Gaps row says which feature made the calls.

targets.rawSql: select case when sum(cost_micro_eur) between 1 and 99 then 0.0001 else trunc(coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur), 0) / 1000000.0, 4) end as value from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and payer = 'unattributed'

panels.title: Internal
panels.description: Samples, staff demos and dev tools: recorded but never charged to an account. Same as Internal in the staff panel.

targets.rawSql: select trunc(coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur), 0) / 1000000.0, 4) as value from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and payer = 'internal'

panels.title: Deleted accounts
panels.description: Cost on accounts that no longer exist at all (the account row was removed). Soft-deleted accounts still exist and show in the Accounts table as deleted. Same as Deleted accounts in the staff panel.

targets.rawSql: select trunc(coalesce(sum(cost_micro_eur), 0) / 1000000.0, 4) as value from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and billing_account_id is not null and billing_account_id not in (select billing_account_id from obs.ai_accounts)

panels.title: Spend by provider
panels.description: Cost in the selected time by the provider that served the model. Unknown means the model is priced by more than one provider.

targets.rawSql: select provider, trunc(sum(cost_micro_eur) / 1000000.0, 4) as cost from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: This period against the previous
panels.description: Cost over the complete UTC days of the selected time (today is left out until it is over) against the same number of complete days just before, and the change in percent. Shows n/a when there is no complete day yet, or when the previous period had no cost.

targets.rawSql:
with r as (select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz as f, $__timeTo()::timestamptz as t),
w as (select cf, ct, ct - cf + 1 as n from (select (((f at time zone 'UTC') - interval '1 microsecond')::date + 1) as cf, (least((t at time zone 'UTC')::date, (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date) - 1) as ct from r) x),
s as (select sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) filter (where day between (select cf from w) and (select ct from w)) as cur, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) filter (where day between (select cf - n from w) and (select cf - 1 from w)) as prev from obs.ai_spend_base where day >= (select cf - n from w) and day <= (select ct from w))
select case when n < 1 then null else trunc(coalesce(cur, 0), 4) end as "This period", case when n < 1 then null else trunc(coalesce(prev, 0), 4) end as "Previous period of equal length", case when n < 1 or coalesce(prev, 0) = 0 then null else round(100 * (cur - prev) / prev, 1) end as "Change" from w cross join s

panels.title: Unattributed spend by feature
panels.description: Cost that no account and no internal payer was found for, in the selected time. Each line says which feature made the calls, so the code path that lost the account can be found.

targets.rawSql:
with o as (select operation, model, sum(calls) as calls, sum(cost_micro_eur) as cost from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and payer = 'unattributed' group by 1, 2)
select f.group_label as "group", f.feature, o.operation, o.model, o.calls, trunc(o.cost / 1000000.0, 4) as cost
from o cross join lateral obs.ai_feature(o.operation) f order by 6 desc, 3, 4

panels.title: Calls with no operation or no payer, last 30 days
panels.description: Calls of the last 30 days recorded without an operation or without a payer (unattributed), newest first. For calls without an operation the service (api or worker), the model group and the kind of call identify the code path. Does not follow the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
select to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day, payer, service, case when operation = '' then 'none' else operation end as operation, model_group as "model group", kind, model, calls, trunc(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0, 4) as cost
from obs.ai_call_gaps order by 1 desc, cost_micro_eur desc, 3, 4

panels.title: Operations without a name
panels.description: Operations the feature rules do not recognise, so they sit in the group Other. A new operation here means a name is missing. An empty operation shows as Unlabelled.

targets.rawSql:
with o as (select operation, sum(calls) as calls, sum(cost_micro_eur) as cost from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1)
select f.feature as operation, sum(o.calls) as calls, trunc(sum(o.cost) / 1000000.0, 4) as cost
from o cross join lateral obs.ai_feature(o.operation) f where f.feature_group = 'other' group by 1 order by 3 desc, 1

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts with cost in the selected time, biggest first. Cost follows the time picker; budget, percent used and override end are as of now.

targets.rawSql:
select a.name, left(a.billing_account_id::text, 8) as id, a.tier, a.account_scope as scope, trunc(s.cost, 4) as "cost in range", a.budget_micro_eur / 1000000.0 as budget, a.percent_used as "percent used", a.unlimited, a.override_until as "override ends", a.deleted
from obs.ai_accounts a join (select billing_account_id, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as cost from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1) s on s.billing_account_id = a.billing_account_id
order by s.cost desc, a.billing_account_id

panels.title: Free accounts at 80% of budget or more, now
panels.description: Free accounts that have used 80% or more of their AI budget this period, as of now. Not affected by the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
select name, left(billing_account_id::text, 8) as id, percent_used as "percent used", trunc(period_spend_micro_eur / 1000000.0, 4) as "spent this period", budget_micro_eur / 1000000.0 as budget, custom_budget as "custom budget", override_until as "override ends"
from obs.ai_accounts where percent_used >= 80 and not deleted and not unlimited order by percent_used desc, name

panels.title: By feature
panels.description: Cost by feature in the selected time. Follows the Account dropdown. Share is the part of the cost shown here.

targets.rawSql:
with o as (select operation, sum(calls) as calls, sum(cost_micro_eur) as cost from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and ('__all' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR billing_account_id::text IN (${account:sqlstring})) group by 1)
select f.group_label as "group", f.feature, sum(o.calls) as calls, trunc(sum(o.cost) / 1000000.0, 4) as cost, sum(o.cost) / 1000000.0 / nullif(sum(o.calls), 0) as "cost per call", sum(o.cost) / nullif(sum(sum(o.cost)) over (), 0) as share
from o cross join lateral obs.ai_feature(o.operation) f group by 1, 2 order by 4 desc, 1, 2

panels.title: By operation
panels.description: Cost by operation, the way the staff AI costs panel lists them, with the feature each one belongs to. Follows the Account dropdown.

targets.rawSql:
with o as (select operation, sum(calls) as calls, sum(cost_micro_eur) as cost from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and ('__all' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR billing_account_id::text IN (${account:sqlstring})) group by 1)
select f.group_label as "group", f.feature, o.operation, o.calls, trunc(o.cost / 1000000.0, 4) as cost
from o cross join lateral obs.ai_feature(o.operation) f order by 5 desc, 3

panels.title: By model and provider
panels.description: Cost, calls and tokens by model and provider. Follows the Account dropdown.

targets.rawSql:
select model, provider, sum(calls) as calls, sum(input_tokens) as "input tokens", sum(output_tokens) as "output tokens", trunc(sum(cost_micro_eur) / 1000000.0, 4) as cost
from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and ('__all' IN (${account:sqlstring}) OR billing_account_id::text IN (${account:sqlstring})) group by 1, 2 order by 6 desc, 1

panels.title: Spend per day by feature group
panels.description: Cost per UTC day, split by feature group.

targets.rawSql:
with o as (select day, operation, sum(cost_micro_eur) as cost from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1, 2)
select (o.day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, f.group_label as metric, sum(o.cost) / 1000000.0 as value
from o cross join lateral obs.ai_feature(o.operation) f group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Spend per day by model
panels.description: Cost per UTC day, split by model.

targets.rawSql: select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, model as metric, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as value from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Unattributed and internal spend per day
panels.description: Cost per UTC day with no account to charge: unattributed, and internal (samples, demos, dev tools).

targets.rawSql: select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, payer as metric, sum(cost_micro_eur / 1000000.0) as value from obs.ai_spend_base where $__timeFilter(day) and payer in ('unattributed', 'internal') group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Calls without a price, last 7 days
panels.description: Calls in the last 7 UTC days whose model had no price, so their cost is missing. Counted from the per-call records, which the app keeps for 90 days; the 7 days are this panel's own window.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(price_missing_calls), 0) as value from obs.ai_call_quality where day > (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 7

panels.title: Calls with estimated usage, last 7 days
panels.description: Share of calls in the last 7 UTC days whose token counts were estimated because the provider reported none. Counted from the per-call records, which the app keeps for 90 days; the 7 days are this panel's own window.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(usage_estimated_calls)::numeric / nullif(sum(calls), 0), 0) as value from obs.ai_call_quality where day > (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 7
